geography.definition: Categories are labels, not spatial observations.
geography.anchorRule: Use true country polygons for ISO-coded rows; use an abstract labelled ring for nongeographic rows. Never scatter aggregate values into cities or invent country intensity.

time.updateCadence: Manual reviewed refresh on source revision; never imply a live feed.

uncertainty: Source precision retained. No confidence interval is invented. Applicant list does not resolve ultimate beneficial ownership or individual inventors. No inventor-to-owner flow can be inferred by joining unrelated top-five and top-ten totals.
